defs.d: To accept as true, particularly without absolute certainty (i.e., as opposed to knowing)
defs.ex: I believe there are faeries.

defs.d: To accept that someone is telling the truth.
defs.ex: Why did I ever believe you?

defs.d: A strip of fabric, especially from the edge of a piece of cloth.
Material used for cloth selvage.
To create or recite a list.
To place in listings.
Frequent.
Frequently, many times.
defs.ex: I often walk to work when the weather is nice.

defs.d: A substance that is applied as a liquid or paste, and dries into a solid coating that protects or adds color/colour to an object or surface to which it has been applied.
(in the plural) A set of containers or blocks of paint of different colors/colours, used for painting pictures.
To apply paint to.
To apply in the manner that paint is applied.
Someone who is associated with another in a common activity or interest.
One of the pieces of wood comprising the framework which strengthens the deck of a wooden ship around the holes through which the mast and other fittings pass.
To join as a partner.
(often with with) To work or perform as a partner.
One who adjusts, especially for the insurance industry's employment title "loss adjuster" (or "claims adjuster" in the United States).
A knob or disc that is passed through a loop or (buttonhole), serving as a fastener.
defs.ex: April fastened the buttons of her overcoat to keep out the wind.

defs.d: A mechanical device meant to be pressed with a finger in order to open or close an electric circuit or to activate a mechanism.
defs.ex: Pat pushed the button marked "shred" on the blender.

defs.d: In a violin-family instrument, the carved wooden plug which sits in the bottom block of the instrument.
Along, together with others, in a group, etc.
defs.ex: Do you want to come with?

defs.d: Against.
defs.ex: He picked a fight with the class bully.

defs.d: In the company of; alongside, close to; near to.
defs.ex: He went with his friends.

defs.d: An actual event, situation, or fact.
defs.ex: For a change, in this case, he was telling the truth.

defs.d: A given condition or state.
To propose hypothetical cases.
A large building that is fortified and contains many defences; in previous ages often inhabited by a nobleman or king.
An instance of castling.
To house or keep in a castle.
To protect or separate in a similar way.
Two times.
(usually with "as", of a specified quality) Doubled in quantity, intensity, or degree.
A stroke; a blow.
A pulsation or throb.
defs.ex: a beat of the heart; the beat of the pulse

defs.d: To hit; strike
defs.ex: As soon as she heard that her father had died, she went into a rage and beat the wall with her fists until her knuckles bled.

defs.d: To strike or pound repeatedly, usually in some sort of rhythm.
defs.ex: He danced hypnotically while she beat the atabaque.

defs.d: Exhausted
defs.ex: After the long day, she was feeling completely beat.

defs.d: Dilapidated, beat up
defs.ex: Dude, you drive a beat car like that and you ain’t gonna get no honeys.

defs.d: A person or thing that is acting or capable of acting.
Any component that is not passive. See Passivity (engineering).
Having the power or quality of acting; causing change; communicating action or motion; acting;—opposed to passive, that receives.
defs.ex: certain active principles

defs.d: Quick in physical movement; of an agile and vigorous body; nimble.
defs.ex: an active child or animal

defs.d: The process of imparting knowledge, skill and judgment.
defs.ex: 2016-06-17 AROP JOSEPH "Education is the slight hammer that breaks the yoke of ignorance, and moulds knowledge, skills, ideas, good moral values in a person be it a child, a youth or full grown adult. no matter a persons age learning never stops".

defs.d: Facts, skills and ideas that have been learned, either formally or informally.
defs.ex: He has had a classical education.

defs.d: One who directs; the person in charge of managing a department or directorate (e.g., director of engineering), project, or production (as in a show or film, e.g., film director).
A counselor, confessor, or spiritual guide.
The total number of goals, points, runs, etc. earned by a participant in a game.
defs.ex: The player with the highest score is the winner.

defs.d: The number of points accrued by each of the participants in a game, expressed as a ratio or a series of numbers.
defs.ex: The score is 8-1 even though it's not even half-time!

defs.d: To cut a notch or a groove in a surface.
defs.ex: The baker scored the cake so that the servers would know where to slice it.

defs.d: To record the tally of points for a game, a match, or an examination.
Acknowledgement of success
A soft or foolish person; an idiot.
Ellipsis of soft tyre (A tyre whose compound is softer than mediums, and harder than supersofts.)
Easily giving way under pressure.
defs.ex: My head sank easily into the soft pillow.

defs.d: (of cloth or similar material) Smooth and flexible; not rough, rugged, or harsh.
defs.ex: Polish the silver with a soft cloth to avoid scratching.

defs.d: Softly; without roughness or harshness; gently; quietly.
Something to play with, especially as intended for use by a child.
defs.ex: A grown man does not play with a child’s toy.

defs.d: A thing of little importance or value; a trifle.
To play (with) in an idle or desultory way.
defs.ex: Figo is toying with the English defence.

defs.d: To ponder or consider.
defs.ex: I have been toying with the idea of starting my own business.

defs.d: To give advice to; to offer an opinion to, as worthy or expedient to be followed.
defs.ex: The dentist advised me to brush three times a day.

defs.d: To recommend; to offer as advice.
defs.ex: The dentist advised brushing three times a day.

defs.d: To follow in order; to come next after; hence, to take the place of.
defs.ex: Autumn succeeds summer.

defs.d: To obtain the object desired; to accomplish what is attempted or intended; to have a prosperous issue or termination; to be successful.
defs.ex: The persecution of any righteous practice has never succeeded in the face of history; in fact, it can expedite the collapse of the persecutory regime.

defs.d: A contest, a struggle.
defs.ex: the battle of life

defs.d: A general action, fight, or encounter, in which all the divisions of an army are or may be engaged; a combat, an engagement.
To join in battle; to contend in fight
defs.ex: Scientists always battle over theories.

defs.d: To fight or struggle; to enter into a battle with.
defs.ex: She has been battling cancer for years.

defs.d: An intense distressing emotion of fear or repugnance.
Something horrible; that which excites horror.
defs.ex: I saw many horrors during the war.

defs.d: An amount by which a quantity is decreased.
defs.ex: One research team has recorded Baishui’s decrease at about 27 meters per year over the last 10 years.

defs.d: A reduction in the number of stitches, usually accomplished by suspending the stitch to be decreased from another existing stitch or by knitting it together with another stitch. See Decrease (knitting).
Of a quantity, to become smaller.
To make (a quantity) smaller.
A defect; something that detracts from perfection.
A mistake or error.
defs.ex: No! This is my fault, not yours.

defs.d: To criticize, blame or find fault with something or someone.
To fracture.
Someone or something wished for.
defs.ex: It is my desire to speak with you.

defs.d: Strong attraction, particularly romantic or sexual.
defs.ex: His desire for her kept him awake at night.

defs.d: To want; to wish for earnestly.
defs.ex: I desire to speak with you.

defs.d: To put a request to (someone); to entreat.
A sudden snatch at something.
An acquisition by violent or unjust means.
To grip suddenly; to seize; to clutch.
defs.ex: I grabbed her hand to pull her back from the cliff edge.

defs.d: To make a sudden grasping or clutching motion (at something).
defs.ex: The suspect suddenly broke free and grabbed at the policeman's gun.

defs.d: The act of granting; a bestowing or conferring; concession; allowance; permission.
The yielding or admission of something in dispute.
(ditransitive) to give (permission or wish)
defs.ex: He was granted permission to attend the meeting.

defs.d: (ditransitive) To bestow or confer, with or without compensation, particularly in answer to prayer or request; to give.
An operation (often an integration) that converts one function into another.
A function so produced.
To change greatly the appearance or form of.
defs.ex: The alchemists sought to transform lead into gold.

defs.d: To change the nature, condition or function of; to change in nature, disposition, heart, character, etc.; to convert.
A melody.
A song, or short musical composition.
To adjust (a musical instrument) so that it produces the correct pitches.
defs.ex: to tune a piano or a violin

defs.d: To adjust or modify (esp. a mechanical or electrical device) so that it functions optimally.
defs.ex: Tune your mind, and anything becomes possible.

defs.d: Used to show appreciation or approval of a song.
defs.ex: You heard the new Rizzle Kicks song? — Tune!

defs.d: One who, or that which, is pure.
To hit (the ball) completely cleanly and accurately
defs.ex: Tiger Woods pured his first drive straight down the middle of the fairway.

defs.d: To cleanse; to refine.
Free of flaws or imperfections; unsullied.
Free of foreign material or pollutants.

Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).
Any given region or area of the world.
To divide into or assign sections or areas.
defs.ex: Please zone off our staging area, a section for each group.

defs.d: To define the property use classification of an area.
defs.ex: This area was zoned for industrial use.
